evals.name: oas32-adapters-and-reference-wiring
evals.prompt: The namespace package apidom-ns-openapi-3-2 is being added (assume it exists and mirrors apidom-ns-openapi-3-1, exporting OpenApi3_2Element, refractorPluginReplaceEmptyElement and mediaTypes for version 3.2.0). Create the JSON and YAML parser adapters for it and plan the apidom-reference integration. Produce: the src/adapter.ts and src/media-types.ts files of apidom-parser-adapter-openapi-json-3-2 and apidom-parser-adapter-openapi-yaml-3-2, and integration-plan.md listing every file to create or modify in apidom-reference (and anywhere else), including the exact saturated.ts changes.
evals.expected_output: Adapters whose detection regexes match only 3.2.x documents, plus a complete integration plan.
assertions: JSON adapter detectionRegExp matches "openapi": "3.2.0" and "3.2.1" and does not match 3.1.0 or 3.0.3
YAML adapter detectionRegExp matches openapi: 3.2.0 (plain, quoted, and JSON-style) and does not match 3.1.0
JSON and YAML media types cover OpenAPI 3.2.0 (derived from the 3.2 namespace by format, or listed explicitly)
Plan adds apidom-reference parse parsers openapi-json-3-2 and openapi-yaml-3-2
Plan adds resolve, dereference and bundle strategies for openapi-3-2
Plan registers parsers and all three strategies in saturated.ts
Plan updates apidom-reference package.json (dependencies and exports)
Plan addresses detection exclusivity or registration order against the 3.1 adapters
